# Mitishell v1.3.1

Actions and image clipboard history were intended for v1.3.0 but did not make that release. v1.3.1 completes both.

## New Features

- The launcher now has a searchable Actions menu for the screenshot, text extraction, QR scanning, recording, power-profile, and firmware-update actions from the existing `desktop-actions` script. Mitishell actions already present in search are not duplicated, and missing optional commands hide only their related entries.
- Recording stays inside the launcher through region or output and audio choices. An active recording replaces the start entries with Stop Recording.
- Clipboard history now records supported raster images alongside text. Image entries show thumbnails, dimensions, and format, and can be searched, copied again, deleted, or cleared like text entries.
- Clipboard images are stored privately beside the history file, deduplicated by content, and removed when their entries leave history. Existing text-only history migrates without losing entries.

## Install

Download the archive matching your system and `SHA256SUMS` from this release. Then run:

```bash
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing
tar -xzf mitishell-v1.3.1-linux-amd64.tar.gz    # or mitishell-v1.3.1-linux-arm64.tar.gz
cd mitishell-v1.3.1-linux-amd64
make install-prebuilt
quickshell -n -p ~/.local/share/mitishell/shell
```
